text:
Simon Nemec was the second overall pick in 2022 and is now in Calgary after 155 games with New Jersey, and the Calgary Herald is asking what his ceiling is. He is playing 21 minutes a night, scored on the rush against Chicago, and has ten points in 24 games. One assist came with help from the Flames' equipment manager, per Sportsnet, which is a story in itself.

The five-on-five numbers are a work in progress. Calgary takes 45% of the expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), almost five points worse than without him, and the team has scored about 3.7 fewer goals than its chances with him out there. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking likes his defending at the line: he stops 18% of the entries aimed at him, against 11% for a typical defenseman. Evolving-Hockey had him 72nd among 215 defensemen last season. He is 22, on a rebuilding team, with time to grow into the minutes. Our range has him around 34 points.
